camel_example: aliyun alidns DescribeDomainLogs --region cn-hangzhou --StartDate '2019-07-04' --Type domain --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --endDate '2019-07-04' --KeyWord test --Lang en --GroupId 20000
description_en: Queries the operation logs for a domain name based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取域名的操作日志
kebab_example: aliyun alidns describe-domain-logs --lang en --key-word test --group-id 20000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --start-date 2019-07-04 --end-date 2019-07-04 --type domain --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDomainLogs

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response.

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is zh
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。
zh：中文
en：英文

默认为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the query. A case-insensitive \`contains\` search is performed
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，按照“%KeyWord%”模式搜索，不区分大小写
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name group. If you do not specify this parameter, all groups are queried
parameters.help_zh: 域名分组ID。为空时，查询所有分组
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date. The format is YYYY-MM-DD
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The type of content to query.

domain: domain name

slavedns: secondary DNS

If you do not specify this parameter, all types are queried
parameters.help_zh:
查询内容类型。

domain：域名
slavedns：辅助DNS

为空时，查询所有类型
parameters.name: type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of logs returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询获取的日志数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalCount.description_zh: 日志列表中日志的数量
